d: Chestnut brown hair styled in large, spiky tufts with a thick fringe of bangs, paired with a youthful face of an adolescent and an athletic build. The eyes are a deep brown, almond-shaped with a determined expression. The outfit consists of a blue short-sleeved shirt with a yellow star on the right sleeve and yellow collar trim, brown cargo shorts, white gloves, and a blue headband with silver-rimmed goggles. Accessories include a gold medallion on a white cord and a black wristband. Beside this figure is a small reptilian dinosaur-like creature with a large head, green eyes, and a yellow-gold scale texture. BODY COLOR: yellow-gold LEGS: digitigrade with three blunt claws per foot
